name: lazyfinder-sidebar-git
criterio: order 2026-10-13-06 point 6 (the project sidebar shows git state in VS Code letters and colors, and follows stage, commit and checkout by itself)
cmd: cd "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj" && export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null && g() { git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false "$@"; } && g init -q -b trunk . && g add . && g commit -q -m init && echo changed >> notes.txt && echo x > loose.txt && (sleep 2; g add loose.txt; sleep 2; g commit -q -am second; sleep 2; g checkout -q -b feature; sleep 1; echo y > made-by-agent.txt) & sleep 0.5; exec "${LAZYFINDER_BIN}" --follow "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj"

steps.desc: the branch is in the title
modified is M and an untracked file is U
the letters, at the right edge, have the colors of VS Code: yellow M, green U
git add by another program turns U into A on its own
a new file appears by itself, marked as new
